Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effect reads, "Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck," so if possible, you must reveal 3 cards. If you have fewer than 3 cards left in your deck, reveal as many as you can.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [On Play] effect force me to reveal 3 cards from the top of my deck?

Card Q&A.a: Yes. The effect reads, “Add 1 card...to your hand,” so if you reveal a card that meets the requirements, you must add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: This card's [On Play] effect reveals cards from the top of my deck. If I reveal a card with [Free] in its traits, do I have to add it to my hand?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Free] in its traits among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
